title: incident-bot: prioritize SLO autodiagnostics suggestions based on on-call context
author: Ava Chen
description:
Context: On-call engineers have limited time during incidents; the incident-bot's SLO autodiagnostics suggestions were returning long lists of possible checks with little ordering, which made it harder to find high-value next steps. This PR introduces a lightweight prioritization pipeline that ranks autodiagnostic suggestions by on-call context (severity, service ownership, recent noisy signals) and surfaces the top N items in the on-call flow.

What this changes: - Adds a priority scoring function that weights suggestion relevance by incident severity, whether the service is on the alerting path, recent related incidents, and SLI impact. - Persists a minimal on-call context blob in the incident ephemeral cache to avoid recomputing expensive lookups. - Updates incident-bot UI payload to include "priority_score" and reorders suggestion lists in the Slack/Console outputs. - Adds feature flag (incident_bot.priority_ranking=true) and rollout plan (20% orgs -> 50% -> 100%).

Why: Early on-call feedback showed devs ignore low-value suggestions; ranking improves time-to-action and reduces cognitive load. Benchmarks on our canary org show median time-to-first-action reduced by ~18% in simulated incidents.

Rollout and safety: - Feature gated behind a runtime flag. - Default weighting is conservative and can be tuned via SRE config. - Falls back to original ordering if scoring fails.

Testing and validation: - Unit tests cover scoring logic and fallback paths. - Integration tests simulate on-call context with varied severity and ownership. - Manual canary run against sandbox org and staged rollout.

Checklist: - [x] Add priority scoring function and tests
- [x] Cache minimal on-call context
- [x] Expose score in output payloads
- [x] Add feature flag + rollout plan
- [x] Update docs (on-call guide + runbooks)
- [x] CI green

Related: ENG-18234 (autodiagnostics prioritization), SRE-412 (oncall workflow improvements).

Ravi Patel: Nits on naming (suggestion->diagnostic_suggestion) + please add a short note in the runbook about interpreting priority_score. Fixed both in latest commit.
Maya Singh: Verified the feature flag rollout config; recommend starting at 10% for infra-critical orgs. Added an infra exclusion list to rollout file.

release_notes: Prioritizes and ranks incident-bot SLO autodiagnostics suggestions by on-call context. Feature gated; rollout configurable. Improves time-to-first-action in canary orgs.
